harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Repaired /srv/inventory on node1: created system user inventorysvc and group inventory-readers, recursively chowned the tree to inventorysvc:inventory-readers, and set permissions to u=rwX,g=rX,o= (dirs 750, files 640). Verified a group member can read the data while an unrelated user is denied at both file and directory level, and that original file contents (records.csv, config.json) are byte-identical (sha256 unchanged) before and after. Completed the mandatory single-node restart: captured baseline boot_id, issued `systemctl reboot`, polled until reachable, confirmed boot_id changed, and reverified ownership/permissions/data integrity post-restart.
actions_performed: Inspected /srv/inventory ownership/permissions and existing content on node1
Confirmed inventorysvc user and inventory-readers group did not exist
Captured file contents/checksums for preservation verification
Created group inventory-readers and system user inventorysvc (primary group inventory-readers)
Recursively chowned /srv/inventory to inventorysvc:inventory-readers
Recursively chmod'd to u=rwX,g=rX,o= (750/640)
Verified data integrity via sha256sum and content diff pre/post change
Created temporary test users to verify group-read access works and outsider access is denied, then removed them
Captured pre-restart boot_id and health baseline
Issued systemctl reboot on node1, acknowledgement returned before disconnect
Polled node1 until exec succeeded again
Confirmed boot_id changed, proving actual restart
Reverified ownership, permissions, group membership, and file checksums/content post-restart

evidence.requirement: Existing data preserved (contents unchanged) during repair
evidence.summary: records.csv/config.json content and sha256 captured before chown/chmod and confirmed identical after
inventorysvc user did not exist, was created, then /srv/inventory recursively chowned to inventorysvc:inventory-readers (ls -l confirms owner)

evidence.requirement: Data readable by inventory-readers group, inaccessible to other users
evidence.summary: chmod applied u=rwX,g=rX,o=; a test user in inventory-readers could read records.csv, while an unrelated test user got Permission denied on both file read and directory listing
Captured boot_id 8f258838-... plus permissions and checksums on /srv/inventory prior to reboot
systemctl reboot issued in background; REBOOT_ACK_SENT returned successfully before node dropped

evidence.requirement: Node1 boot identity changed (proof of actual restart)
evidence.summary: Node unreachable during reboot, then boot_id read as 6714a474-... differing from pre-restart 8f258838-...

evidence.requirement: Post-restart recovery of repaired state and data
evidence.summary: After restart: inventorysvc/inventory-readers still exist, /srv/inventory permissions unchanged (750/640, correct owner/group), and sha256 checksums of records.csv/config.json match pre-restart baseline exactly
